first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and we have two durable memories showing that signup simplification (memory_31) and shortened onboarding (memory_86) both produced measurable activation and completion lifts. These are low-risk, high-confidence interventions with no documented retention harm. Verifying both will confirm the magnitude of prior gains and help calibrate this week's test for maximum impact. We avoid promotional_pricing (memory_73 shows it damages 30-day retention despite acquisition lift) and enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44 is valuable but requires sales capacity we may lack visibility into). Referral_incentive (memory_57) works well for existing customers but does not address the activation and onboarding completion declines. Activation_messaging (memory_91) is worth considering but simplifying onboarding is more structural and addresses both declining metrics simultaneously.
